name: W Punta de Mita
positioning: A lively, surf-styled W beach resort on Playa Veneros in Riviera Nayarit, with Huichol-inspired design, a beach-view pool scene and suites with private pools and rooftops
best_for: Surfers and beach lovers who want waves steps from the room
Couples and friends who want a social pool scene and suites with private pools

facts.text: A certified surf vendor offers private and group lessons by advance booking.
The hotel is 20 minutes from Sayulita and 10 minutes from Marina La Cruz.
Rooms have bohemian surf touches and Mexican accents, including woven screens, surfboards and murals.
Rooms and suites have private balconies with ocean or jungle views.
Bathrooms are open-concept with deep soaking baths and glass-enclosed showers.
The Oasis Villa Presidential Suite has two bedrooms, an oceanview living room, an outdoor jacuzzi and a rooftop with 360-degree views.
Mesa 1 is a private outdoor seven-course dinner on an island in the center of a spring-fed lake.
Rubra, led by chef Daniela Soto-Innes, uses ingredients harvested from the hotel's own garden.
AWAY Spa has a jungle setting with customized spa therapies and beauty treatments.
The Agave Lab is a guided tequila, mezcal and raicilla tasting.
The Marietas Islands, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, are nearby.

highlights.text: The hotel is set along Playa Veneros, and guests can walk down from their rooms to fast-breaking beach waves with left and right rides.
The W Suite's rooftop has panoramic views of the resort and ocean, a plunge pool, a fire pit and lounge chairs.
Ground-floor beachfront suites, steps from the sand, have a private pool.
The WET outdoor pool overlooks the beach and is reached from the Living Room via the blue and green mosaic Camino Huichol walkway.
The design blends colonial grandeur with the artistry of the indigenous Huichol peoples.

considerations.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls the hotel more stylish and party-oriented than most of its counterparts in Punta Mita.
Puerto Vallarta, home to the airport, is less than an hour away.
WhataHotel notes the party-focused atmosphere may not suit guests seeking a tranquil retreat.
